scenario_context: Multi-issue: late delivery + damaged item. Apologize for both, confirm order, request minimal evidence politely if required, refund only after return initiated, offer expedited pickup/replacement, set update cadence, escalate if refusal.

customer_profile.opening_message: Late and broken. Refund me right now.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent schedules pickup immediately and gives firm refund timeline

checkpoints.description: Acknowledge BOTH issues (late + broken) and apologize
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Validate both complaints before proposing steps.

checkpoints.description: Confirm order details and delivery date
Request minimal evidence politely if required (photo)
Explain refund constraint softly (after return initiated) and propose expedited pickup
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Move to pickup initiation and timeline; avoid arguing.

checkpoints.description: Provide clear timeline + next update time and summarize plan; offer escalation if refusal
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Give one confident plan with timing.

success_summary: Multi-issue de-escalation with immediate action plan and refund timeline.
